scope: TRAIN128 first native contact transition. Native task flags at end of the 10ms tick. Local first-contact position uses the recorded world contact point and interpolated native racket pose at its time. Margin is projected distance inside the scoring string polygon (negative = outside), not distance to the actual metal collider. Predicted class is first analytic collider in this tick from observed starting state and actual command. The robot endpoint substitution is offline diagnostic only. Neither WM snapshot is assumed to be the exact interaction-time WM.
